scientific_integrity: Same mathematical model proof reconstruction, exact integral graph verification, literature-implication comparison; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact induced-torus isomorphism is established for the quintic Frobenius class only, not for all eighteen W(D5) conjugacy types.
The theorem concerns the identity component of the Picard scheme of the reduced nodal boundary, not its other multidegree components.
The motivic/zeta and q-squared first-field counts are corollaries with earlier prior-implied counting content and are not the core originality claim.
The discriminant-quintic interpretation is restricted to characteristic different from two; the geometric signed-cycle theorem and construction apply in all characteristics.
Rybakov (2005) was bibliographically accessible, but its full text was not inspected; historical priority is provisional.
title: Five induced quintic tori for the sixteen-line boundary of a quartic del Pezzo surface
